source: Sample data modeled on Tamil Nadu Agricultural University (TNAU) Agronomy Guidelines. Verify with local agricultural officers before field implementation.

sowing_window.notes: Late sowing past Oct 20 increases vulnerability to northeast monsoon submergence during flowering.

resilient_varieties.name: Swarna Sub1
resilient_varieties.recommended_for: Low-lying, flood-prone blocks in Cauvery Delta

resilient_varieties.name: Anna 4
resilient_varieties.recommended_for: Tail-end areas prone to Cauvery canal deficit

tasks: Summer deep ploughing to expose dormant weed seeds and pathogens.
Strengthen field bunds to 30 cm height and 40 cm width to prevent runoff.
Seed treatment with Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 10g/kg seed.
Transplant 18-20 day old seedlings with 2-3 seedlings per hill (20x10 cm spacing).
Basal fertilizer: NPK 50:50:50 kg/ha with 25 kg Zinc Sulphate.
Maintain thin water film (1-2 cm) during initial seedling establishment.
Apply 1st top dressing of Nitrogen (25 kg/ha).
Intermittent irrigation (alternate wetting and drying) to promote root depth.
Monitor leaf tips for blast spindle lesions and leaf folder folding.
Apply 2nd top dressing of Nitrogen and Potash (25 kg N + 25 kg K2O/ha).
Keep standing water 3-5 cm during panicle formation.
Inspect for water deficit stress; foliar spray 1% Urea + 1% KCl if canal supply lags.
Clear all drainage channels and field bund outlets ahead of NE monsoon cyclonic bursts.
Maintain water level at 2-3 cm; avoid deep submergence of flowering panicles.
If heavy continuous rainfall (>100mm) is forecast, drain excess water immediately.
Drain field water completely 10-14 days before intended harvest.
Harvest when 80-85% grains turn golden yellow and moisture reaches ~20%.
Thresh and sun-dry paddy to 13% moisture for safe grain storage.

risk_rules.name: Paddy Blast Disease (Pyricularia oryzae)
risk_rules.condition_desc: Relative humidity > 85% for 3 or more days during tillering (weeks 5-7)
risk_rules.advisory: High humidity blast risk detected. Apply Tricyclazole 75 WP @ 1g/L or spray bio-agent Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 5g/L immediately.

risk_rules.name: Canal Deficit / Vegetative Water Stress
risk_rules.condition_desc: NDVI drops > 15% below seasonal baseline during panicle initiation (weeks 8-10)
risk_rules.advisory: Crop stress dip detected. Irrigate plot within 48 hours or apply 1% urea foliar spray to preserve panicle development.

risk_rules.name: Flash Flood Submergence Risk
risk_rules.condition_desc: Weekly rainfall exceeds 150mm during grain filling (weeks 11-13)
risk_rules.advisory: Monsoon flood alert: >150mm rainfall recorded. Open perimeter drainage sluices and pump out stagnant water from field depressions.

pre_disaster_protocol: 1. Dig shallow diversion trenches across low-lying corners to channel runoff away.
2. Clear weeds and silt from plot discharge pipes connecting to secondary canals.
3. Secure harvested or nursery materials on elevated bund platforms.
4. Post-flood: Spray 1% Potassium Chloride (KCl) + 0.5% Zinc Sulphate to accelerate revival.
